The '''Beledeen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Southern Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Beledeen II]]''.<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Beledeen system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
